evidence: Source reasoning through each floor case (the skill's verify procedure for #39 is to reason through blank, static mock, seed copy, keyword-stuffed and refusing submissions). Deterministic layer: tests/scoring.toml:1-11 gates render/constraints at 0.0, floors functional=0.05; tests/tools/score.py:41 gates_passed = all(score > 0) and :48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0; test.sh:213-221 runs gates first and on score.py exit 1/other leaves/writes zero and never runs scored; test.sh:8 zero record written first and probes /api/health then / (lines 48,136), so an app that does not start or serve scores 0. test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py and scoring.toml are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff). Gate criteria: gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires a refused wrong password plus a real Recruiter sign-in to a usable workspace and states 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> a blank page, a keyword-stuffed page or a static screenshot fails. gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 requires creating a job (title, team, manager, 2 places) and a candidate through ordinary UI controls, then reading both back in a new independent browser context as the Observer, and explicitly fails 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app' -> a static/client-side mock (localStorage does not cross a new browser context), a seed-copy serving fixed JSON, and a submission that refuses every action all fail; any gate failure zeroes the whole reward. Both gates' creation demands are public: hireops_rules.md:16 ('opens jobs, adds candidates'), :27-34 (title, team, hiring manager, places 1-50; name, email, source). Defence in depth: each scored prompt restates the gate (functional prompt.md:11-13 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'; polish prompt.md:11-12; visual prompt.md:11-12 minimum Likert 1 normalised to zero), and functional prompt.md:13 requires every refusal row to have its own observed positive control, so a refusing app cannot farm refusal rows. Evaluator failure maps to binary0/Likert1 in every prompt (direction is toward zero, not credit). No gate requires same-origin; CDN use is allowed by instruction.md:13, consistent with the row's note. Broken app that could still pass gates (not a floor case, recorded for rows 40/42): a real SQLite server implementing only job open + add candidate + candidate sign-in could pass both gates and earn roughly hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 + hro_candidate_linked 0.5 + hro_restart 1.5 = 4.0 of 58.5 functional weight (6.8%, just above the 0.05 floor) plus low visual Likert; this is a genuinely partial working app, not a shell/mock, so it does not breach this row. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app that requires an extra field not in the rules to open a job, or uses a non-form creation flow, could trip the constraints gate; the gate accepts 'any hiring manager', 'any source' and discovers controls by intent, so a conforming app should pass. Risk=true because no measured runs exist: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; no blank/static/mock/seed-copy/stuffed/refusing app has been graded by the configured judge, so the LLM judge's actual behaviour on a convincing client-side mock (e.g. whether it truly uses a new browser context) is unmeasured.
